final_user_goal: Build a reproducible A-share AI-Core selection process that ultimately works top-down from market context to sector context to stock selection, using free/public data and evidence that can survive prospective validation.
hard_constraints: V2.8.1 promotion results remain immutable: zero factors were promoted.
No V2.8.1 threshold, sample window, PASS condition, direction, multiplicity family or failed-gate result may be changed post hoc.
A direction observed after V2.8.1 results may seed a later hypothesis but cannot be relabeled as a V2.8.1 confirmatory PASS.
AI-Core eligibility remains a separate evidence authority and cannot be inferred from price behavior, sector labels or hindsight winners.
The intended decision architecture is top-down: broad market context -> sector/context layer -> stock layer.
Historical sector/context labels used as authority must be PIT/effective-dated or otherwise temporally defensible; current static labels cannot silently stand in for historical membership.
No setup, episode or live-trading authorization follows from retrospective diagnostic work.
soft_constraints_removed: A standalone full-market cross-sectional factor must promote before any useful strategy architecture can be designed.
Stage-2 combination research must run even when Stage-1 promoted zero factors.
A near-pass factor may be rescued by relaxing the D+10 spread confidence gate.
A factor whose observed sign is opposite the preregistered direction may simply be flipped and rerun on the same outcomes as confirmatory evidence.
Vendor Vintage Drift Audit needs repeated reruns after its immutable PASS evidence is frozen.
The next iteration should add more transforms before establishing whether the missing structure is market/sector conditioning.

counterfactual.delete_stage2_combination: No valid promotion information is lost because V2.8.1 promoted zero factors; forcing a combination would bypass the preregistered gate.
counterfactual.delete_direction_flip_rerun: Preserves anti-optional-stopping integrity; ret_20 and ret_60 remain useful as discovery evidence without being converted into retrospective wins.
counterfactual.avoid_threshold_relaxation: Preserves the economic-strength requirement that prevented statistically detectable but weak extreme-spread effects from being called standalone alpha.
counterfactual.absorb_volatility_ratios: rv10_over_rv60 and tr10_over_tr60 may inform risk/regime conditioning diagnostics without receiving Stage-1 promotion status.
counterfactual.substitute_problem_formulation: Replace unconditional broad-universe one-factor promotion as the immediate objective with a top-down conditional architecture review.
counterfactual.precompute_reuse: Reuse the frozen V2.8.1 source pins, vintage audit, PIT universe, calendar, economic-price rules and canonical panel builder rather than reacquiring or reauditing the same data.
counterfactual.optimize_last: Do not optimize runtime or statistical thresholds until the conditional architecture and temporal-authority requirements are frozen.
